# HumanVisionInspiredSNN

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
A spiking neural network architecture modeled after human retinal and cortical motion-processing pathways to handle temporal deblurring. Provides biologically plausible computation that reduces power consumption and improves temporal fidelity in neuromorphic hardware.
